title: GigaEdge Spench: An SDK for Practical Streaming Speech Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2611.13243v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present GigaEdge Spench, an open-source SDK for streaming speech enhancement on CPU servers, mobile devices, and in browsers. Applications can build enhancement channels from neural denoising, normalization and dynamics blocks, sample-rate conversion, and acoustic echo cancellation where supported. These stages can be combined, while normalization can also run without a neural model. The release includes an 8 kHz INT8 denoiser and discriminative and hybrid 48 kHz FP32 models. A shared C++ core supports ONNX Runtime and TensorFlow Lite through native interfaces, Android and iOS SDKs, and WebAssembly integration. Independent stream contexts share model resources, and consecutive frames from one stream can be processed in a single inference call. We evaluate the released models on EARS-WHAM v2 and compare their quality and processing costs with RNNoise and DPDFNet2. All tested native and Web configurations process files faster than real

translated_title: GigaEdge Spench：一个面向实用流式语音增强的软件开发工具包（SDK）
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 GigaEdge Spench，一个用于在 CPU 服务器、移动设备和浏览器上进行流式语音增强的开源 SDK。应用程序可以由神经去噪、归一化与动态处理模块、采样率转换，以及在支持情况下的声学回声消除来构建增强通道。这些处理阶段可以组合使用，同时归一化也可以在没有神经模型的情况下独立运行。本次发布包含一个 8 kHz INT8 去噪器，以及判别式和混合式的 48 kHz FP32 模型。一个共享的 C++ 核心通过原生接口支持 ONNX Runtime 和 TensorFlow Lite，并提供 Android 和 iOS SDK 以及 WebAssembly 集成。独立的流上下文可以共享模型资源，且来自同一流的连续帧可以在单次推理调用中处理。我们在 EARS-WHAM v2 数据集上评估了发布的模型，并将其质量与处理开销与 RNNoise 和 DPDFNet2 进行了比较。所有测试的原生和 Web 配置处理文件的速度均快于实时。
tldr: 该论文发布了开源 SDK GigaEdge Spench，通过共享 C++ 核心与多平台集成（服务器、移动端、浏览器）实现实用的高速流式语音增强，其模型质量和处理速度优于 RNNoise 和 DPDFNet2 且快于实时。
en_tdlr: The paper releases GigaEdge Spench, an open-source SDK enabling practical streaming speech enhancement across CPU servers, mobile devices, and browsers, whose models outperform RNNoise and DPDFNet2 in quality while running faster than real time.
